title: layer-plan.json
description: The layers that the agent groups the folders of a target into, written to the run folder after map.mjs writes layers.json. Documentation only: scripts/lib/layer-plan.mjs (validateLayerPlan) is the check, and it reports every problem it finds with a JSON pointer. Unknown fields are errors everywhere (additionalProperties is false). Beyond this schema the validator checks that every folder and option is a folder of layers.json by exact match, that no folder of one layer is the same as, inside, or containing a folder of another layer, that an option lies inside one of its layer's folders and neither is a folder of another layer nor lies inside one, and that names are unique when case is ignored.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this format. Must be 1.

layers.description: One entry per layer. At least one layer is required.

name.description: The name of the layer, such as frontend or database. Unique across the layers when case is ignored.

folders.description: The folders of the layer, each one exactly as layers.json lists it. No folder of the layer may be the same as, inside, or containing a folder of another layer.

reason.description: The justification of the layer, from the signals of the mapping.

signals.description: Optional. The signal types that justify the layer.

options.description: Optional. Sub-folders the person may pick inside the layer. Each must be a folder of layers.json, lie inside one of the layer's folders ("." holds every folder), and neither be a folder of another layer nor lie inside one.
